
===== memoryPrintBtn @ 48985 =====
<div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab active" data-dataset="textbook">教科書版</button>
      <button class="tab" data-dataset="exam">高校入試版</button>
      <button class="tab" data-dataset="elementary">小学生版</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="layout">
    <div class="panel controls no-print">
      <h2>しぼりこみ</h2>

      <div id="textbookQuick" class="section">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn" id="memoryToggleBtn">暗記練習用にする</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="starBtn">☆のみ</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="phraseBtn">熟語だけ</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="currentBtn">現行確認のみ</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="examQuick" class="section hide">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="exam30Btn">30点目標</button>
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="exam40Btn">40点以上目標</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="examIrregularBtn">不規則動詞だけ</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="elemQuick" class="section hide">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="elemWriteBtn">書けるようにする単語</button>
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="elemMeaningBtn">意味・イメージでわかる単語</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="elemAllBtn">小学生版を全部</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="elemMemoryBtn">暗記練習用にする</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="textbookFilters">
        <details open><summary>教科書 <span class="meta" id="textbookMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="textbookBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>学年 <span class="meta" id="gradeMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="gradeBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>大単元 <span class="meta" id="majorMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="majorBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>小単元 <span class="meta" id="sectionMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="sectionBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>品詞 <span class="meta" id="posMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="posBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div id="examFilters" class="hide">
        <details open><summary>カテゴリ <span class="meta" id="examCategoryMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examCategoryBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>分類 <span class="meta" id="examSubMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examSubBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>品詞 <span class="meta" id="examPosMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examPosBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div id="elementaryFilters" class="hide">
        <details open><summary>テスト区分 <span class="meta" id="elemTypeMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="elemTypeBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>カテゴリー <span class="meta" id="elemCategoryMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="elemCategoryBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">問題数</label>
        <select id="qCount">
          <option value="5">5問</option>
          <option value="10" selected>10問</option>
          <option value="15">15問</option>
          <option value="20">20問</option>
          <option value="30">30問</option>
          <option value="99999">全部</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">印刷配置</label>
        <select id="printLayout">
          <option value="normal" selected>通常</option>
          <option value="duplex10">表10問・裏10問</option>
        </select>
        <div class="smallnote" style="margin-top:6px">20問テストのときは、1枚目に1〜10、2枚目に11〜20が出ます。両面印刷向けです。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">出題形式</label>
        <select id="quizMode">
          <option value="en2jp">英語→日本語</option>
          <option value="jp2en">日本語→英語</option>
          <option value="random">ランダム</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">☆とそれ以外の出題ルール</label>
        <select id="starQuizRule">
          <option value="normal" selected>通常（出題形式どおり）</option>
          <option value="star_both_nonstar_read">☆は読み・書き／それ以外は読みだけ</option>
        </select>
        <div class="smallnote" style="margin-top:6px">読み＝英語→日本語、書き＝日本語→英語。特別ルールでは☆語は両方、☆なし語は読みだけで出します。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="section inline">
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="refreshBtn">一覧更新</button>
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="makeTestBtn">テスト作成</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="toggleAnswersBtn">答え表示</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="printBtn">問題を印刷</button>
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="pdfPreviewBtn">PDFで表示</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="answerPrintBtn">解答を印刷</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="memoryPrintBtn">暗記プリントを印刷</button>
      </div>
      <div class="smallnote">小学生版は「書ける」と「意味・イメージ」を分けてテスト化できます。</div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel">
      <div class="main-top no-print">
        <span class="badge" id="datasetBadge">教科書版</span>
        <span class="smallnote" id="listModeLabel">通常一覧</span>
      </div>
      <div class="summarybox" id="summary"></div>

      <div id="memoryGroupedArea" class="memory-area hide"></div>

      <div id="listArea">
        <div class="tablewrap">
          <table id="listTable">
            <thead><tr id="theadRow"></tr></thead>
            <tbody></tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="summarybox" id="testSummary">テスト未作成</div>
      <div id="testArea" class="test-area"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="printSheet"></div>

function waitForPrintImages(sheet) {
  const imgs = Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll('img'));
  if (!imgs.length) return Promise.resolve();
  const waits = imgs.map(img => {
    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
      if (img.decode) {
        return img.decode().catch(() => Promise.resolve());
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      img.onload = () => {
        if (img.decode) {
          img.decode().then(resolve).catch(resolve);
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      };
      img.onerror = resolve;
    });
  });
  return Promise.all(waits).then(() => Promise.resolve());
}
function nextPaint() {
  return new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
}
async function runPrint(mode) {
  const oldClasses = ['test-print', 'answer-print', 'memory-print', 'print-sheet'];
  document.body.classList.remove(...oldClasses);
  const sheet = document.getElementById('printSheet');

  if (mode === 'memory') {
    if (state.dataset === 'exam') {
      alert('高校入試版は暗記プリントではなく、問題印刷または解答印刷を使ってください。');
      return;
    }
    if (!state.currentList.length) {
      alert('印刷する単語がありません。条件を確認してください。');
      return;
    }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildMemoryPrintHtml();
  } else {
    if (!state.currentTest.length) {
      alert('先に「テスト作成」を押してください。');
      return;
    }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildTestPrintHtml(mode === 'answer');
  }

  document.body.classList.add('print-sheet');
  if (mode === 'answer') document.body.classList.add('answer-sheet');

  await waitForPrintImages(sheet);
  await nextPaint();
  window.print();
}
window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
  document.body.classList.remove('test-print', 'answer-print', 'memory-print', 'print-sheet', 'answer-sheet');
});
els.printBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runPrint('test'));
els.pdfPreviewBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runPrint('test'));
els.answerPrintBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runPrint('answer'));
els.memoryPrintBtn.addEventListener('click', () => runPrint('memory'));

function renderList() {

    els.listArea.classList.add('hide');
    els.memoryGroupedArea.classList.remove('hide');
    const blocks = [];
    let current = '';
    let intro = '';
    let rows = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (!current || rows.length === 0) return;
      const head = state.dataset === 'elementary'
        ? `<thead><tr><th style="width:22%">英語</th><th style="width:22%">カタカナ読み</th><th style="width:22%">日本語</th><th>コツ・セット</th></tr></thead>`
        : `<thead><tr><th style="width:30%">英語</th><th style="width:30%">カタカナ読み</th><th>日本語</th></tr></thead>`;
      const introHtml = intro ? `<div class="memory-intro">${esc(intro)}</div>` : '';
      blocks.push(`<div class="memory-section"><div class="memory-title">${esc(current)}</div>${introHtml}<table class="memory-table">${head}<tbody>${rows.join('')}</tbody></table></div>`);
    };
    state.currentList.forEach(r => {
      const title = state.dataset === 'elementary' ? r.elem_category : r.section;
      const nextIntro = state.dataset === 'elementary' ? (r.elem_intro || '') : '';
      if (title !== current) {
        flush();
        current = title;
        intro = nextIntro;
        rows = [];
      }
      if (state.dataset === 'elementary') rows.push(`<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_hint || '')}</td></tr>`);
      else rows.push(`<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td></tr>`);
    });
    flush();
    els.memoryGroupedArea.innerHTML = blocks.join('');
    return;
  }
  els.listArea.classList.remove('hide');
  els.memoryGroupedArea.classList.add('hide');
  els.memoryGroupedArea.innerHTML = '';
  if (state.dataset === 'textbook') {
    if (state.memoryMode) {
      els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>学年</th><th>英語</th><th>カタカナ読み</th><th>日本語</th><th>現行確認</th><th>☆</th>`;
      els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>中${esc(String(r.grade).replace('.0',''))}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${String(r.current_confirmed)==='1' ? '○' : ''}</td><td>${String(r.star)==='1' ? '☆' : ''}</td></tr>`).join('');
    } else {
      els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>教科書</th><th>学年</th><th>大単元</th><th>小単元</th><th>品詞</th><th>英語</th><th>日本語</th><th>現行</th><th>☆</th>`;
      els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.textbook)}</td><td>中${esc(String(r.grade).replace('.0',''))}</td><td>${esc(r.major_unit)}</td><td>${esc(r.section)}</td><td>${esc(r.pos)}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${String(r.current_confirmed)==='1' ?     }
  } else if (state.dataset === 'exam') {
    els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>カテゴリ</th><th>分類</th><th>品詞</th><th>英語</th><th>日本語</th>`;

  } else {

    els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.elem_type)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_category_short || r.elem_category)}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_hint || '')}</td></tr>`).join('');
  }
}
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = arr.slice();
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function createTest() {
  state.currentList = filteredRows();
  renderSummary();
  renderList();
  const rows = state.currentList.slice();
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    state.currentTest = [];
    els.testSummary.textContent = '該当語がありません';
    els.testArea.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const specialRule = els.starQuizRule && els.starQuizRule.value === 'star_both_nonstar_read';
  const candidates = [];
  if (specialRule) {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (String(r.star || '') === '1') {
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'en2jp' });
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'jp2en' });
      } else {
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'en2jp' });
      }
    });
  } else {
    rows.forEach(r => candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: '' }));
  }
  const count = Math.min(parseInt(els.qCount.value, 10), candidates.length);
  const picked = shuffle(candidates).slice(0, count).map((item, idx) => {
    const r = item.row;
    let mode = item.fixedMode || els.quizMode.value;
    if (mode === 'random') mode = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'en2jp' : 'jp2en';
    const prompt = mode === 'en2jp' ? r.english : r.japanese;
    const answer = mode === 'en2jp' ? r.japanese : r.english;
    return { no: idx + 1, mode, prompt, answer, kana: '', extra: '', star: String(r.star || '') === '1' };
  });
  state.currentTest = picked;
  state.answersVisible = false;
  renderTest();
}
function renderTest() {
  els.testSummary.textContent = state.currentTest.length ? `${state.currentTest.length}問作成済み` : 'テスト未作成';
  els.testArea.innerHTML = state.currentTest.map(q => {
    const label = q.mode === 'en2jp' ? '英語→日本語' : '日本語→英語';
    return `<div class="test-card"><div class="qline">Q${q.no} <span class="badge">${label}</span></div><div>${esc(q.prompt)}</div><div class="ans ${state.answersVisible ? 'show' : ''}">答え: ${esc(q.answer)}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function clearCurrentTest() {
  state.currentTest = [];
  state.answersVisible = false;
}
function refresh() {
  state.currentList = filteredRows();
  renderSummary();
  renderList();
  renderTest();
}
function setDataset(name) {
  state.dataset = name;
  state.answersVisible = false;
  state.currentTest = [];
  if (name === 'textbook') {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  } else if (name === 'exam') {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  } else {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  }
  els.tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.dataset === name));
  els.textbookFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'textbook');
  els.examFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'exam');
  els.elementaryFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'elementary');
  els.textbookQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'textbook');
  els.examQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'exam');
  els.elemQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'elementary');
  renderAllFilters();
  refresh();
  updateQuickButtons();
}

  // 印刷用の body クラスは runPrint() だけで制御する。

}
function updateQuickButtons() {
  els.memoryToggleBtn.textContent = state.memoryMode ? '通常一覧に戻す' : '暗記練習用にする';
  els.elemMemoryBtn.textContent = state.memoryMode ? '通常一覧に戻す' : '暗記練習用にする';
  els.starBtn.classList.toggle('primary', state.toggles.starOnly);
  els.phraseBtn.classList.toggle('primary', state.toggles.phraseOnly);
  els.currentBtn.classList.toggle('primary', state.toggles.currentOnly);
  syncBodyMode();
}
function setExamTarget(target) {
  if (target === '30') state.filters.examCategory = new Set(['書ける最優先','英作文の型']);
  else if (target === '40') state.filters.examCategory = new Set(['書ける最優先','長文テーマ語','英作文の型','40点超え追加']);
  else if (target === 'irregular') state.filters.examCategory = new Set(['不規則動詞']);
  state.filters.examSub = new Set();
  state.filters.examPos = new Set();
  clearCurrentTest();
  renderAllFilters();
  refresh();
}
function setElementaryType(mode) {
  if (mode === 'write') state.filters.elemType = new Set(['書けるようにする']);
  else if (mode === 'meaning') state.filters.elemType = new Set(['意味・イメージでわかる']);
  else state.filters.elemType = new Set(['書けるようにする','意味・イメージでわかる']);
  clearCurrentTest();
  renderAllFilters();
  refresh();
}

    els.listArea.classList.add('hide');
    els.memoryGroupedArea.classList.remove('hide');
    const blocks = [];
    let current = '';
    let intro = '';
    let rows = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (!current || rows.length === 0) return;
      const head = state.dataset === 'elementary'
        ? `<thead><tr><th style="width:22%">英語</th><th style="width:22%">カタカナ読み</th><th style="width:22%">日本語</th><th>コツ・セット</th></tr></thead>`
        : `<thead><tr><th style="width:30%">英語</th><th style="width:30%">カタカナ読み</th><th>日本語</th></tr></thead>`;
      const introHtml = intro ? `<div class="memory-intro">${esc(intro)}</div>` : '';
      blocks.push(`<div class="memory-section"><div class="memory-title">${esc(current)}</div>${introHtml}<table class="memory-table">${head}<tbody>${rows.join('')}</tbody></table></div>`);
    };
    state.currentList.forEach(r => {
      const title = state.dataset === 'elementary' ? r.elem_category : r.section;
      const nextIntro = state.dataset === 'elementary' ? (r.elem_intro || '') : '';
      if (title !== current) {
        flush();
        current = title;
        intro = nextIntro;
        rows = [];
      }
      if (state.dataset === 'elementary') rows.push(`<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_hint || '')}</td></tr>`);
      else rows.push(`<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td></tr>`);
    });
    flush();
    els.memoryGroupedArea.innerHTML = blocks.join('');
    return;
  }
  els.listArea.classList.remove('hide');
  els.memoryGroupedArea.classList.add('hide');
  els.memoryGroupedArea.innerHTML = '';
  if (state.dataset === 'textbook') {
    if (state.memoryMode) {
      els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>学年</th><th>英語</th><th>カタカナ読み</th><th>日本語</th><th>現行確認</th><th>☆</th>`;
      els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>中${esc(String(r.grade).replace('.0',''))}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${String(r.current_confirmed)==='1' ? '○' : ''}</td><td>${String(r.star)==='1' ? '☆' : ''}</td></tr>`).join('');
    } else {
      els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>教科書</th><th>学年</th><th>大単元</th><th>小単元</th><th>品詞</th><th>英語</th><th>日本語</th><th>現行</th><th>☆</th>`;
      els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.textbook)}</td><td>中${esc(String(r.grade).replace('.0',''))}</td><td>${esc(r.major_unit)}</td><td>${esc(r.section)}</td><td>${esc(r.pos)}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${String(r.current_confirmed)==='1' ? '○' : ''}</td><td>${String(r.star)==='1' ? '☆' : ''}</td></tr>`).join('');
    }
  } else if (state.dataset === 'exam') {
    els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>カテゴリ</th><th>分類</th><th>品詞</th><th>英語</th><th>日本語</th>`;
    els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.exam_category)}</td><td>${esc(r.exam_subcategory || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.pos || '')}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  } else {
    els.headRow.innerHTML = `<th>テスト区分</th><th>カテゴリー</th><th>英語</th><th>日本語</th><th>コツ・セット</th>`;
    els.listBody.innerHTML = state.currentList.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.elem_type)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_category_short || r.elem_category)}</td><td><strong>${esc(r.english)}</strong></td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_hint || '')}</td></tr>`).join('');
  }
}
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = arr.slice();
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function createTest() {
  state.currentList = filteredRows();
  renderSummary();
  renderList();
  const rows = state.currentList.slice();
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    state.currentTest = [];
    els.testSummary.textContent = '該当語がありません';
    els.testArea.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const specialRule = els.starQuizRule && els.starQuizRule.value === 'star_both_nonstar_read';
  const candidates = [];
  if (specialRule) {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (String(r.star || '') === '1') {
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'en2jp' });
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'jp2en' });
      } else {
        candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: 'en2jp' });
      }
    });
  } else {
    rows.forEach(r => candidates.push({ row: r, fixedMode: '' }));
  }
  const count = Math.min(parseInt(els.qCount.value, 10), candidates.length);
  const picked = shuffle(candidates).slice(0, count).map((item, idx) => {
    const r = item.row;
    let mode = item.fixedMode || els.quizMode.value;
    if (mode === 'random') mode = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'en2jp' : 'jp2en';
    const prompt = mode === 'en2jp' ? r.english : r.japanese;
    const answer = mode === 'en2jp' ? r.japanese : r.english;
    return { no: idx + 1, mode, prompt, answer, kana: '', extra: '', star: String(r.star || '') === '1' };
  });
  state.currentTest = picked;
  state.answersVisible = false;
  renderTest();
}
function renderTest() {
  els.testSummary.textContent = state.currentTest.length ? `${state.currentTest.length}問作成済み` : 'テスト未作成';
  els.testArea.innerHTML = state.currentTest.map(q => {
    const label = q.mode === 'en2jp' ? '英語→日本語' : '日本語→英語';
    return `<div class="test-card"><div class="qline">Q${q.no} <span class="badge">${label}</span></div><div>${esc(q.prompt)}</div><div class="ans ${state.answersVisible ? 'show' : ''}">答え: ${esc(q.answer)}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function clearCurrentTest() {
  state.currentTest = [];
  state.answersVisible = false;
}
function refresh() {
  state.currentList = filteredRows();
  renderSummary();
  renderList();
  renderTest();
}

  state.dataset = name;
  state.answersVisible = false;
  state.currentTest = [];
  if (name === 'textbook') {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  } else if (name === 'exam') {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  } else {
    state.memoryMode = false;
  }
  els.tabs.forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.dataset === name));
  els.textbookFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'textbook');
  els.examFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'exam');
  els.elementaryFilters.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'elementary');
  els.textbookQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'textbook');
  els.examQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'exam');
  els.elemQuick.classList.toggle('hide', name !== 'elementary');
  renderAllFilters();
  refresh();
  updateQuickButtons();
}

  state.filters.examSub = new Set();
  state.filters.examPos = new Set();
  clearCurrentTest();
  renderAllFilters();
  refresh();
}

function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = arr.slice();
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function createTest() {

';

function rbModeClass(q) { return q.mode === 'en2jp' ? 'en2jp' : 'jp2en'; }
function rbModeLabel(q) { return q.mode === 'en2jp' ? '英語→日本語' : '日本語→英語'; }
function rbPageLabel(i) { return i===0 ? '表面' : i===1 ? '裏面' : `${i+1}ページ目`; }
function rbHeader(withAnswers) {
  const tag = withAnswers ? '<div class="rb-answertag">解答用</div>' : '';
  return `${tag}<img class="rb-headimg" src="${RB_HEAD_SRC}" alt="英単語テストヘッダー"><div class="rb-range">範囲：${esc(buildPrintRangeLine())}</div><div class="rb-student"><div>名前<span class="rb-line"></span></div><div>日付<span class="rb-line"></span></div><div>点数<span class="rb-line score"></span> /100点</div></div>`;
}
function rbMiniHeader(withAnswers, pageIndex) {
  return `<div class="rb-minihead"><div class="title">${withAnswers ? '英単語テスト 解答' : '英単語テスト'}</div><div class="range">範囲：${esc(buildPrintRangeLine())}</div><div class="page">${rbPageLabel(pageIndex)}</div></div>`;
}
function rbInstruction(withAnswers) {
  return `<div class="rb-inst">${withAnswers ? '作成された問題の解答です。確認・丸つけに使いましょう。' : '次の日本語を英語に、または英語を日本語にしなさい。'}</div>`;
}
function rbQuestionRow(q, withAnswers) {
  const star = q.star ? '<span class="rb-star">★</span>' : '';
  const box = withAnswers ? `<div class="rb-box answer">${esc(q.answer)}</div>` : '<div class="rb-box"></div>';
  return `<div class="rb-row"><div class="rb-no">${q.no}</div><div class="rb-mode ${rbModeClass(q)}">${esc(rbModeLabel(q))}</div><div class="rb-prompt">${esc(q.prompt)}${star}</div>${box}</div>`;
}
function rbFooter() { return `<div class="rb-footer"><img src="${RB_FOOT_SRC}" alt="ていねいに書こう"></div>`; }

buildTestPrintHtml = function(withAnswers) {
  const useDuplex10 = els.printLayout && els.printLayout.value === 'duplex10';
  if (!useDuplex10) {
    const rows = state.currentTest.map(q => rbQuestionRow(q, withAnswers)).join('');
    return `<div class="rb-page">${rbHeader(withAnswers)}${rbInstruction(withAnswers)}<div class="rb-rows">${rows}</div>${rbFooter()}</div>`;
  }
  const pages = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < state.currentTest.length; i += 10) pages.push(state.currentTest.slice(i, i + 10));
  return pages.map((pageRows, idx) => {
    const head = idx === 0 ? rbHeader(withAnswers) : rbMiniHeader(withAnswers, idx);
    const rows = pageRows.map(q => rbQuestionRow(q, withAnswers)).join('');
    return `<div class="rb-page">${head}${rbInstruction(withAnswers)}<div class="rb-rows">${rows}</div>${rbFooter()}</div>`;
  }).join('');
};

buildMemoryPrintHtml = function() {
  const rows = state.currentList.slice();
  const groups = new Map();
  rows.forEach(r => {
    const key = state.dataset === 'textbook' ? (r.section || r.major_unit || 'その他') : (r.level || r.unit || r.category || r.type || 'その他');
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(r);
  });
  const body = Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([g, arr]) => `
    <div class="rb-memory-group">
      <h3>${esc(g)}</h3>
      ${arr.map(r => `<div class="rb-mem-row"><div class="rb-mem-en">${esc(r.english)}</div><div class="rb-mem-ja">${esc(r.japanese)}</div><div class="rb-mem-kana">${esc(r.kana || '')}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>`).join('');
  return `<div class="rb-page"><img class="rb-headimg" src="${RB_HEAD_SRC}" alt="暗記練習ヘッダー"><div class="rb-memory-title">暗記練習プリント</div><div class="rb-memory-sub">範囲：${esc(buildPrintRangeLine())}</div>${body}${rbFooter()}</div>`;
};

async function rbWaitImages(root) {
  const imgs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('img'));
  await Promise.all(imgs.map(img => new Promise(resolve => {
    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
      if (img.decode) img.decode().then(resolve).catch(resolve); else resolve();
    } else { img.onload = () => resolve(); img.onerror = () => resolve(); }
  })));
}
async function rbNextPaint() { return new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); }
runPrint = async function(mode) {
  const oldClasses = ['test-print', 'answer-print', 'memory-print', 'print-sheet'];
  document.body.classList.remove(...oldClasses);
  const sheet = document.getElementById('printSheet');
  if (mode === 'memory') {
    if (state.dataset === 'exam') { alert('高校入試版は暗記プリントではなく、問題印刷または解答印刷を使ってください。'); return; }
    if (!state.currentList.length) { alert('印刷する単語がありません。条件を確認してください。'); return; }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildMemoryPrintHtml();
  } else {
    if (!state.currentTest.length) { alert('先に「テスト作成」を押してください。'); return; }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildTestPrintHtml(mode === 'answer');
  }
  document.body.classList.add('print-sheet');
  if (mode === 'answer') document.body.classList.add('answer-sheet');
  await rbWaitImages(sheet); await rbNextPaint(); window.print();
};

<meta name="mikami-offline-pwa" content="v1">
<link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.webmanifest">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1f6feb">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="みかみ塾 英単語">
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <div class="topbar no-print">
    <div>
      <div class="title">英単語アプリ（統合版）</div>
      <div class="muted">教科書版 / 高校入試版 / 小学生版</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab active" data-dataset="textbook">教科書版</button>
      <button class="tab" data-dataset="exam">高校入試版</button>
      <button class="tab" data-dataset="elementary">小学生版</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="layout">
    <div class="panel controls no-print">
      <h2>しぼりこみ</h2>

      <div id="textbookQuick" class="section">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn" id="memoryToggleBtn">暗記練習用にする</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="starBtn">☆のみ</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="phraseBtn">熟語だけ</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="currentBtn">現行確認のみ</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="examQuick" class="section hide">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="exam30Btn">30点目標</button>
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="exam40Btn">40点以上目標</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="examIrregularBtn">不規則動詞だけ</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="elemQuick" class="section hide">
        <div class="quick-buttons">
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="elemWriteBtn">書けるようにする単語</button>
          <button class="quick-btn secondary" id="elemMeaningBtn">意味・イメージでわかる単語</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="elemAllBtn">小学生版を全部</button>
          <button class="quick-btn" id="elemMemoryBtn">暗記練習用にする</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="textbookFilters">
        <details open><summary>教科書 <span class="meta" id="textbookMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="textbookBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>学年 <span class="meta" id="gradeMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="gradeBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>大単元 <span class="meta" id="majorMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="majorBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>小単元 <span class="meta" id="sectionMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="sectionBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>品詞 <span class="meta" id="posMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="posBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div id="examFilters" class="hide">
        <details open><summary>カテゴリ <span class="meta" id="examCategoryMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examCategoryBox"></div></details>
        <details><summary>分類 <span class="meta" id="examSubMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examSubBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>品詞 <span class="meta" id="examPosMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="examPosBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div id="elementaryFilters" class="hide">
        <details open><summary>テスト区分 <span class="meta" id="elemTypeMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="elemTypeBox"></div></details>
        <details open><summary>カテゴリー <span class="meta" id="elemCategoryMeta"></span></summary><div class="checklist" id="elemCategoryBox"></div></details>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">問題数</label>
        <select id="qCount">
          <option value="5">5問</option>
          <option value="10" selected>10問</option>
          <option value="15">15問</option>
          <option value="20">20問</option>
          <option value="30">30問</option>
          <option value="99999">全部</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">印刷配置</label>
        <select id="printLayout">
          <option value="normal" selected>通常</option>
          <option value="duplex10">表10問・裏10問</option>
        </select>
        <div class="smallnote" style="margin-top:6px">20問テストのときは、1枚目に1〜10、2枚目に11〜20が出ます。両面印刷向けです。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">出題形式</label>
        <select id="quizMode">
          <option value="en2jp">英語→日本語</option>
          <option value="jp2en">日本語→英語</option>
          <option value="random">ランダム</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="section">
        <label class="smallnote">☆とそれ以外の出題ルール</label>
        <select id="starQuizRule">
          <option value="normal" selected>通常（出題形式どおり）</option>
          <option value="star_both_nonstar_read">☆は読み・書き／それ以外は読みだけ</option>
        </select>
        <div class="smallnote" style="margin-top:6px">読み＝英語→日本語、書き＝日本語→英語。特別ルールでは☆語は両方、☆なし語は読みだけで出します。</div>
      </div>

      <div class="section inline">
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="refreshBtn">一覧更新</button>
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="makeTestBtn">テスト作成</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="toggleAnswersBtn">答え表示</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="printBtn">問題を印刷</button>
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="pdfPreviewBtn">PDFで表示</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="answerPrintBtn">解答を印刷</button>
        <button class="action-btn" id="memoryPrintBtn">暗記プリントを印刷</button>
      </div>
      <div class="smallnote">小学生版は「書ける」と「意味・イメージ」を分けてテスト化できます。</div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel">
      <div class="main-top no-print">
        <span class="badge" id="datasetBadge">教科書版</span>
        <span class="smallnote" id="listModeLabel">通常一覧</span>
      </div>
      <div class="summarybox" id="summary"></div>

      <div id="memoryGroupedArea" class="memory-area hide"></div>

      <div id="listArea">
        <div class="tablewrap">
          <table id="listTable">
            <thead><tr id="theadRow"></tr></thead>
            <tbody></tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="summarybox" id="testSummary">テスト未作成</div>
      <div id="testArea" class="test-area"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

function buildPrintMetaHtml() {
  return `範囲：${esc(buildPrintRangeLine())}`;
}
function sideLabel(index) {
  if (index === 0) return '表面';
  if (index === 1) return '裏面';
  return `${index + 1}ページ目`;
}
function mkDirectionLabel(q) {
  return q.mode === 'en2jp' ? '英語→日本語' : '日本語→英語';
}
function mkDirectionClass(q) {
  return q.mode === 'en2jp' ? 'en2jp' : 'jp2en';
}
function mkQuestionRow(q, withAnswers) {
  const star = q.star ? '<span class="mk-star">★</span>' : '';
  const answer = withAnswers ? `<div class="mk-answer">${esc(q.answer)}</div>` : '<div class="mk-blank"></div>';
  return `<div class="mk-q"><div class="mk-no">${q.no}</div><div class="mk-dir ${mkDirectionClass(q)}">${esc(mkDirectionLabel(q))}</div><div class="mk-prompt">${esc(q.prompt)}${star}</div>${answer}</div>`;
}
function mkFullHeader(title, withAnswers) {
  const tag = withAnswers ? '<div class="mk-answer-tag">解答用</div>' : '';
  return `<div class="mk-top">${tag}<img class="mk-art" src="${MK_HEADER_ART_SRC}" alt="英単語テスト"></div>
  <div class="mk-range">${buildPrintMetaHtml()}</div>
  <div class="mk-student"><div>名前<span class="mk-line"></span></div><div>日付<span class="mk-line"></span></div><div>点数<span class="mk-line mk-scoreline"></span> /100点</div></div>`;
}
function mkCompactHeader(title, idx) {
  return `<div class="mk-compact-head"><div class="mk-compact-title">${esc(title)}</div><div class="mk-compact-range">${buildPrintMetaHtml()}</div><div class="mk-page-label">${esc(sideLabel(idx))}</div></div>`;
}
function mkInstruction(withAnswers) {
  return `<div class="mk-instruction">${withAnswers ? '作成された問題の解答です。確認・丸つけに使いましょう。' : '次の日本語を英語に、または英語を日本語にしなさい。'}</div>`;
}
function mkFooter() {
  return `<div class="mk-footer"><img src="${MK_FOOTER_ART_SRC}" alt="ていねいに書こう"></div>`;
}
function buildTestPrintHtml(withAnswers) {
  const title = withAnswers ? '英単語テスト 解答' : '英単語テスト';
  const useDuplex10 = els.printLayout && els.printLayout.value === 'duplex10';
  if (!useDuplex10) {
    const qHtml = state.currentTest.map(q => mkQuestionRow(q, withAnswers)).join('');
    return `<div class="mk-page">${mkFullHeader(title, withAnswers)}${mkInstruction(withAnswers)}<div class="mk-questions">${qHtml}</div>${mkFooter()}</div>`;
  }
  const pages = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < state.currentTest.length; i += 10) pages.push(state.currentTest.slice(i, i + 10));
  return pages.map((pageRows, idx) => {
    const header = idx === 0 ? mkFullHeader(title, withAnswers) : mkCompactHeader(title, idx);
    const instruction = idx === 0 ? mkInstruction(withAnswers) : '';
    const qHtml = pageRows.map(q => mkQuestionRow(q, withAnswers)).join('');
    const cls = idx === 0 ? 'mk-page' : 'mk-page compact';
    return `<div class="${cls}">${header}${instruction}<div class="mk-questions">${qHtml}</div>${mkFooter()}</div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function buildMemoryPrintHtml() {
  const groups = new Map();
  state.currentList.forEach(r => {
    const key = r.section || r.major_unit || r.exam_category || '暗記練習';
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(r);
  });
  const blocks = Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([title, rows]) => {
    const hasHint = state.dataset === 'elementary';
    const head = hasHint ? '<tr><th>英語</th><th>読み</th><th>意味</th><th>コツ・セット</th></tr>' : '<tr><th>英語</th><th>読み</th><th>意味</th></tr>';
    const body = rows.map(r => hasHint ? `<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td><td>${esc(r.elem_hint || '')}</td></tr>` : `<tr><td>${esc(r.english)}</td><td>${esc(r.kana || '')}</td><td>${esc(r.japanese)}</td></tr>`).join('');
    return `<div class="ps-section"><div class="ps-section-title">${esc(title)}</div><table class="ps-table"><tbody>${head}${body}</tbody></table></div>`;
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="ps-title">暗記練習プリント</div>${buildPrintMetaHtml()}${blocks}`;
}

function waitForPrintImages(sheet) {
  const imgs = Array.from(sheet.querySelectorAll('img'));
  if (!imgs.length) return Promise.resolve();
  const waits = imgs.map(img => {
    if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
      if (img.decode) {
        return img.decode().catch(() => Promise.resolve());
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      img.onload = () => {
        if (img.decode) {
          img.decode().then(resolve).catch(resolve);
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      };
      img.onerror = resolve;
    });
  });
  return Promise.all(waits).then(() => Promise.resolve());
}
function nextPaint() {
  return new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
}
async function runPrint(mode) {
  const oldClasses = ['test-print', 'answer-print', 'memory-print', 'print-sheet'];
  document.body.classList.remove(...oldClasses);
  const sheet = document.getElementById('printSheet');

  if (mode === 'memory') {
    if (state.dataset === 'exam') {
      alert('高校入試版は暗記プリントではなく、問題印刷または解答印刷を使ってください。');
      return;
    }
    if (!state.currentList.length) {
      alert('印刷する単語がありません。条件を確認してください。');
      return;
    }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildMemoryPrintHtml();
  } else {
    if (!state.currentTest.length) {
      alert('先に「テスト作成」を押してください。');
      return;
    }
    sheet.innerHTML = buildTestPrintHtml(mode === 'answer');
  }

  document.body.classList.add('print-sheet');
  if (mode === 'answer') document.body.classList.add('answer-sheet');

  await waitForPrintImages(sheet);
  await nextPaint();
  window.print();
}
window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
  document.body.classList.remove('test-print', 'answer-print', 'memory-print', 'print-sheet', 'answer-sheet');
});

    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-range { font-size:9.5pt; margin:0 0 6px; padding:4px 6px; line-height:1.25; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-page-label { font-size:9.5pt; margin:0 0 4px; }

    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-blank { min-height:14px; margin-top:4px; padding-top:4px; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:fixed; font-size:10.5pt; line-height:1.25; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table th,
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table td { border:1px solid #777; padding:4px 5px; vertical-align:top; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table th { background:#f2f2f2; font-weight:900; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table .ps-no { width:10mm; text-align:center; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table .ps-kind { width:28mm; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table .ps-answercell { width:48%; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table tbody td { height:16.5mm; }
    body.print-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table .ps-answerline { display:block; min-height:11mm; border-bottom:1px solid #bbb; }
    body.print-sheet.answer-sheet .duplex10 .ps-compact-table tbody td { height:auto; min-height:0; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-qhead { font-weight:900; margin-bottom:5px; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-prompt { font-size:14pt; font-weight:800; margin:4px 0 8px; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-answer { border-top:1px dashed #888; padding-top:5px; margin-top:6px; font-weight:800; color:#000; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-blank { border-top:1px dashed #bbb; padding-top:6px; margin-top:8px; min-height:22px; color:#333; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-section { break-inside:avoid; page-break-inside:avoid; margin:0 0 12px; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-section-title { font-size:14pt; font-weight:900; margin:0 0 6px; padding:4px 0; border-bottom:2px solid #333; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:10.5pt; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-table th, body.print-sheet .ps-table td { border:1px solid #888; padding:5px 7px; vertical-align:top; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-table th { background:#f2f2f2; font-weight:900; }
    body.print-sheet .ps-note { font-size:10pt; color:#333; margin-top:8px; }
